description.text: The promos of Japan's MEGA Series, with an M-P suffix and PROMO in place of an expansion code, released since 1 August 2025, when 001/M-P Chikorita came in the first MEGA Series Pokémon Card Gym Promo Card Pack. They come in Pokémon Card Gym and Extra Battle Day packs, at Friend Battle Together, Scramble Battle and Championship Series events, in Endorsed Independent Event Trainers Packs, from McDonald's Japan and in the 30th Celebration card sets. Matching M-P promos also come out in Traditional Chinese, Thai, Indonesian and Korean. The set is still growing.

description.text: The Mega Evolution-era print of Victory Symbol, the trophy card of Japan's Champions League, which had been awarded since 2023. It was never sold or given to entrants: only the top finishers of each league received one, in a print for their place. This 3rd Place print went to the players who finished third and fourth in each league at the 2026 season's tournaments, in Yokohama, Fukuoka, Aichi (twice) and Osaka, and continues into the 2027 season; small text on the Champions League logo names the placing and the city of each copy.

description.text: The Mega Evolution-era print of Victory Symbol, the trophy card of Japan's Champions League, which had been awarded since 2023. It was never sold or given to entrants: only the top finishers of each league received one, in a print for their place. This Champion print went to the winner of each league at the 2026 season's tournaments, in Yokohama, Fukuoka, Aichi (twice) and Osaka, and continues into the 2027 season; small text on the Champions League logo names the placing and the city of each copy.
